articles.title: Coinbase obtuvo la licencia federal de banco fiduciario, pero no podrá aceptar depósitos ni dar préstamos
articles.summary:
Coinbase, plataforma de criptomonedas de Estados Unidos, recibió la aprobación definitiva de la Oficina del Contralor de la Moneda (OCC), el regulador de los bancos nacionales, para operar como banco fiduciario. La empresa lo comunicó el 9 de noviembre; el permiso fue concedido el viernes 6.
La nueva entidad se llama Coinbase National Trust Company. Un banco fiduciario guarda y administra activos de terceros, pero no capta depósitos corrientes ni otorga préstamos. Coinbase había obtenido una aprobación condicional el 2 de abril, según el registro de la OCC citado por el medio especializado crypto.news.
Rick Schonberg, jefe de operaciones de custodia y trading de Coinbase y director ejecutivo de la nueva entidad, dijo en el comunicado que el permiso permite ampliar la custodia de activos digitales “dentro de un marco regulatorio federal coherente”.
La empresa explicó que, hasta ahora, su negocio de custodia operaba bajo una licencia del estado de Nueva York. Coinbase presentó la solicitud el 3 de octubre de 2025, según el medio FinTech Futures.
Qué puede hacer y qué no
La entidad podrá custodiar criptomonedas como fiduciario, sobre todo para clientes institucionales, y permitirá mover dinero y activos dentro de esas cuentas. Bankless, medio especializado, precisa que los dólares de los clientes quedan en cuentas de otros bancos y que el seguro de depósitos federal no aplica.

articles.title: France Blames Iran for Sabotage Attack on Refrigeration Controllers at About 700 Retail Sites
articles.summary:
An October cyberattack on refrigeration controllers at about 700 French retail sites was carried out by a cyber unit of Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), the French government said yesterday.
The attackers broke into controllers on the night of October 11 and changed their defrost settings to high temperatures. That caused food losses and, in at least 15 cases, fires.
The unit is called Shahid Kaveh. It is known mainly through hacktivist personas, such as CyberAveng3rs and Cyber Isnaad Front, that publicly claim some of its attacks, France says.
France's Foreign Ministry plans to summon Iran's ambassador and to ask its European partners to adopt new sanctions against Iranian organizations and individuals involved in the attack.
The Paris prosecutor's office opened a judicial investigation yesterday against the unit's head, the head's two deputies and anyone else identified. It has asked for international arrest warrants. The offenses under investigation include illegally interfering with computer systems and causing damage by means dangerous to people, both made more serious by the aim of serving a foreign power, Iran.
In the October attack, the attackers took remote control of Danfoss and Dixell refrigeration controllers through web interfaces, the prosecutor's office said in a press release. They started abnormal defrost cycles with no time limit and switched off the temperature probes' safety alerts, which should go off above a certain temperature. The attac…

articles.title: Microsoft Hints at WinUI 3 Overhaul for Windows 11's Leftover Legacy Dialogs

Tuesday, November 10th 2026
Microsoft Hints at WinUI 3 Overhaul for Windows 11's Leftover Legacy Dialogs
Marcus Ash, Microsoft's design and research lead for Windows and Devices, has hinted that more of Windows 11's old dialogs and admin tools could get a modern makeover. Under Jen Gentleman's post about the new option to silence the Sticky Keys prompt, a user asked Microsoft to "winui-fy" the legacy Win32 dialogs and MMC apps, and to fully move Control Panel into Settings. Ash replied with a short "Noted and working on that too." He didn't give a timeline or name any tools, so it's more like a nod than a roadmap.
There's plenty to work with, as Windows 11 still ships more than 20 tools with older interfaces, including Defragment and Optimize Drives, Disk Cleanup, Device Manager, Event Viewer, and the DirectX Diagnostic Tool. Folder Options and the Sticky Keys prompt still have no dark mode, and some links in Settings, such as the extra sound and mouse options, open the old Control Panel windows. Microsoft's recent dark mode update for Hyper-V Manager, another legacy tool, also came out incomplete.Microsoft has been at this "overhaul" for a while now. In July, Windows President Pavan Davuluri said WinUI 3 now reaches more of the shell, including the new Run dialog, with AutoPlay and more File and Folder Properties dialogs headed to Experimental Insider builds. articles.title: SAP Patches Four CVSS 10.0 Flaws, Including Two Enabling Remote Code Execution
articles.summary:
Four flaws that attackers could exploit without logging in were fixed today as part of SAP's monthly Security Patch Day—the vendor rates all four 10.0, the maximum CVSS score.
Three are in the SAP NetWeaver application server, the software SAP systems run on, and one is in the Web Dispatcher, which receives web requests from the internet and passes them on to that server.
The flaws in the Web Dispatcher and the Internet Communication Manager (ICM), which handles the server's web traffic, could allow an attacker who can reach the software over the network to run code, the vendor says.
The flaw in the server's SAML 2.0 service provider, which hands off user sign-in to an identity provider, could allow an attacker to log in as any user on some systems that use SAML single sign-on.
The flaw in SAP Gateway, which connects the server to other SAP systems and programs, could allow an attacker to impersonate one of the system's own servers and take unauthorized actions.
None of the four require any user action to work.
Affected Versions and SAP Notes
Each flaw is fixed in its own note, and the affected versions differ by component, according to SAP's November security bulletin. The notes are in SAP for Me, which requires a sign-in, and the vendor strongly recommends applying them as a priority.

And, it’s why once we accept that prevention has its limits, we arrive at an interdiction strategy: finding and disrupting what got in.
After the alert
The alert tells you something happened. However, gaining access to your network doesn’t necessarily mean attackers have stolen data or disrupted the systems they were targeting. They may need to obtain additional access, move to another machine, or further explore the network. Being able to see and understand that activity is the intervention opportunity.
People naturally gravitate toward detections during product evaluations. They’re tangible, easy to compare and quantify, and address the question everyone wants an answer to: Will they catch the attack? There’s often an assumption that the rest will follow, meaning, if the detections are good, surely the investigation will be as well, right?
Whether you can trace the attack, understand the scope, and respond in time to intervene depends largely on the data behind that detection. In network security, a product can have good detections and still leave an analyst struggling to investigate. Perhaps the analyst can see the connection that triggered the alert but can’t follow what happened next. OpenAI lanzó recientemente, en versión de prueba, el Business Hub, una herramienta de ChatGPT con la que las empresas pueden reclamar su perfil, corregir sus datos y crear un agente de IA para que los usuarios conversen sobre sus productos. Los agentes arrancan solo en Estados Unidos.
Según el anuncio de la compañía, ChatGPT lo usan 1.200 millones de personas por semana. Cuando una empresa aparezca en una respuesta del chatbot, el usuario podrá abrir su perfil y, si existe un agente, iniciar una conversación aparte para comparar opciones o resolver dudas.
Esa charla estará identificada de forma clara y separada de la conversación original, y distinta de las respuestas propias de ChatGPT, precisó OpenAI. Las empresas definirán las instrucciones del agente y la información que este puede usar, como detalles de productos o políticas de devolución.
Por ahora, los agentes están disponibles para negocios elegibles de comercio electrónico y servicios en línea de Estados Unidos. La compañía dijo que ampliará el acceso a más tipos de negocios con el tiempo.
Cómo se reclama y se verifica un perfil
Cualquier empresa elegible ubicada donde ChatGPT esté disponible puede reclamar su perfil. Los clientes de ChatGPT Enterprise y los anunciantes pueden hacerlo con su representante de OpenAI, y los comerciantes de Shopify pueden conectar su tienda desde el panel.

Si le monde de l'IA est plein d'argent aujourd'hui, c'est autant dû aux grands investisseurs institutionnels qui ont longtemps ouvert grand leurs coffres - même si ça commence à caler - qu'aux investissements consentis par ceux qui bénéficient directement de cet essor. Une pince, un programmateur USB et un second PC suffisent
Ils démarrent, leur écran s'allume, leur clavier répond. Pourtant, ces portables finissent au recyclage, condamnés par un mot de passe qu'un service informatique a oublié de transmettre. Un youtubeur ukrainien montre comment les libérer avec un petit boîtier vendu une dizaine d'euros, et sa démonstration dépasse déjà 577 000 vues.

On l'y voit déverrouiller un Lenovo ThinkPad T470 dont le BIOS exigeait un mot de passe "superviseur" inconnu. La méthode, relayée le 10 novembre par Tom's Hardware, vise les ThinkPad équipés de processeurs Intel de 4e à 8e génération. Elle n'exige aucune soudure, seulement un programmateur CH341A, une pince et un second ordinateur.
Pourquoi ces ThinkPad d'entreprise se vendent à prix cassé
Les entreprises verrouillent souvent leurs flottes de portables avec ce mot de passe superviseur. Au moment de la revente, le stockage est généralement retiré et le précieux sésame rarement documenté. L'acheteur hérite alors d'une machine dont il ne peut plus modifier les réglages, et ces lots se bradent ou partent au rebut. articles.title: Is DDR4 back? 64GB RAM PCs see major fall, but new data suggests hope is on the horizon
articles.summary:
Is DDR4 back? 64GB RAM PCs see major fall, but new data suggests hope is on the horizon
DDR4 usage surges as soaring memory prices suppress DDR5 adoption
- 64GB RAM PCs fell 18% as memory costs climbed sharply
- 32GB systems also slipped, while 16GB machines gained ground in CPU-Z's survey
- 24GB RAM recorded the fastest growth, despite its tiny market share
Rising memory prices are changing how much RAM consumers are willing to buy, with fewer PC users opting for expensive, high-capacity memory.
A CPU-Z hardware survey shows that the number of computers with 64GB of RAM fell by 18% year over year, while 32GB systems declined by 2.5%.
Yet DDR4 still accounts for 54.5% of surveyed computers, compared with 32.9% for DDR5, suggesting the older memory standard remains far from disappearing.
Rising RAM prices are changing consumer preferences
The decline in larger memory capacities comes as AI infrastructure continues consuming substantial quantities of DRAM, putting pressure on supplies available to conventional PC manufacturers.
As memory becomes more expensive, buyers appear increasingly willing to settle for smaller capacities rather than pay premium prices for additional RAM.
The shift is particularly noticeable among 16GB computers, which recorded a 12.9% annual increase in the survey.
Systems with 8GB of RAM also grew by 5.5%, despite the capacity becoming increasingly inadequate for demanding applications and modern gaming.

articles.title: Google prueba robot humanoide en fábricas de Mercedes-Benz y publica una prueba para evitar que lo engañen
articles.summary:
Google DeepMind presentó Gemini Robotics 2.5, un modelo de IA que controla robots, y probó que un humanoide con ese sistema clasificó piezas en fábricas de Mercedes-Benz con un 96% de aciertos. La compañía publicó además ASIMOV-Jailbreak, una prueba abierta para medir si un robot puede ser engañado.
El anuncio salió el 10 de noviembre en el blog oficial de DeepMind, firmado por Carolina Parada. Según la empresa, es su modelo más capaz para convertir imágenes e instrucciones en acciones físicas. Por ahora llega solo a sus socios de robótica y no hay acceso para el público.
Un humanoide que ordena piezas en dos plantas de Mercedes-Benz
La prueba se hizo con Apptronik, una empresa de robots humanoides, y Mercedes-Benz. El robot Apollo 2 trabajó en líneas de producción activas en Kecskemét, Hungría, y en Sindelfingen, Alemania.
Su tarea fue el kitting: sacar soportes metálicos de cajones con piezas sueltas y colocarlos en bandejas, en el orden que necesita cada vehículo. Según DeepMind, el robot corrigió por su cuenta los huecos que aparecían. El resultado fue un 96% de éxito, que la empresa describe como una prueba piloto.
Jeff Cardenas, cofundador y director ejecutivo de Apptronik, dijo que los modelos mejoraron mucho en pocas semanas de entrenamiento adicional y que pasaron a la fábrica de Mercedes-Benz con muy poca pérdida de rendimiento.

articles.title: Binance Warns of iOS Sandbox Escape That Could Expose Crypto Wallet Keys, No Fix Confirmed
articles.summary:
An iOS sandbox escape published on GitHub lets an app read other apps' files on iPhones running iOS 26 and 27. That puts seed phrases, private keys, and login credentials at risk of exposure to malicious apps, Binance warned today. Apple's updates for iOS 26 and 27, released yesterday, do not list a fix.
A researcher who goes by forcequit, in collaboration with 0xjohnny, released the escape, called worse_query, on Sunday, a day before those updates came out. Neither the exchange nor the researcher reported any attacks or thefts involving it.
The exchange told users to delete apps installed from untrusted sources, such as sideloaded or manually signed apps, and to update iOS and all their apps. No fix for the escape has been confirmed.
For anyone who suspects a breach, the exchange's security warning advises moving funds to a new wallet created on a clean device and resetting all active login sessions.
The researcher's proof-of-concept code can reach every app's data container on an iPhone, and some system folders on iOS 27. To use it, an app has to set up an App Group container.
He says the code is for developers and "isn't useful by itself." Other developers have built apps on it that people can install.
One of them is WQ Files, a file manager that developer Christoph Kolbicz built on worse_query. It reaches other apps' data without a jailbreak or a kernel exploit, and it can edit, delete and clear that data.

Sony retirará la aplicación de PlayStation Plus para PC el 10 de diciembre de 2026.
La herramienta permitía a los suscriptores de PlayStation Plus Premium transmitir determinados juegos desde una computadora, una función que dejará de estar disponible tras el cierre.
La compañía comunicó que notificará directamente a los usuarios afectados. La decisión no modificará las membresías ni los beneficios de PlayStation Plus en las consolas PS5 y PS4.
Según el blog oficial de PlayStation, menos del 0,4% de los suscriptores elegibles de PlayStation Plus Premium utilizaba la aplicación para PC. Sony sostuvo que la baja adopción le permitirá concentrar sus recursos en funciones con mayor demanda entre sus miembros.
Los suscriptores de PlayStation Plus Premium todavía podrán usar la transmisión de juegos a través de una consola compatible o de PlayStation Portal.
Por qué PlayStation cierra este servicio
El argumento central de Sony es el escaso uso de la aplicación de PlayStation Plus en computadoras. La empresa indicó que el servicio no alcanzó una adopción suficiente entre los usuarios del plan Premium.
La aplicación era una de las vías para acceder al juego en la nube desde PC, aunque estaba limitada a una selección de títulos y a los miembros del nivel más alto de la suscripción. Con su retiro, esa alternativa desaparecerá el 10 de diciembre de 2026.

articles.title: Blind Eagle Uses Fake Court Notices to Deliver Remote Access Trojan Across Latin America
articles.summary:
The threat actor known as Blind Eagle has resurfaced with a new campaign targeting organizations in Latin America through judicial and administrative-themed phishing lures to deliver a remote access trojan (RAT) that shares its lineage with AsyncRAT and DCRat.
"The campaign uses Portuguese and Spanish lures that resemble court notifications, fiscalía notices, tutela proceedings, and administrative documents," Zenox said in a report shared with The Hacker News.
Assessed to be a Spanish-speaking group and active since 2018, Blind Eagle (aka APT-C-36) has a track record of using spear-phishing lures to distribute commodity RATs like AsyncRAT, BitRAT, Lime RAT, NjRAT, Quasar RAT, and Remcos RAT.
Attack chains begin with phishing emails targeting individuals who handle cases, contracts, judicial, or institutional service requests to trick them into opening a malware-laced attachment.
One email containing a Colombian judicial-themed XHTML file has been identified as a weaponized Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) image that renders a bogus web page impersonating Colombia's Fiscalía General de la Nación, also referred to as the Office of the Attorney General.
The web page, for its part, employs a technique known as HTML smuggling to assemble the next-stage ZIP archive payload locally in the web browser using ZipCrypto, thereby circumventing email security controls.

Three distinct threat activity clusters with shared infrastructure and malware code similarities have been observed targeting telecommunications providers, government organizations, military entities, research institutions, and critical infrastructure across Latin America, Asia, and Europe over the past year.
Check Point Research is tracking the clusters under the names SilentDelivery, OceanGate, and DarkWire. Although initially assumed to be independent sets of attacks, each with its own backdoors and post-exploitation tooling, they have all been linked through a malware ecosystem called Sparrow.
The entity behind the Sparrow framework has been codenamed CopperDragon, and is assessed to be a digital quartermaster developing tools for China-nexus threat actors, including FamousSparrow, Earth Estries, Tropic Trooper, UAT-9244, and UAT-8302.

articles.title: Hackers Exploit Critical Xen Orchestra Auth Bypass Flaw to Gain Admin Access
articles.summary:
French software company Vates VMS has warned of a critical security vulnerability in Xen Orchestra that it said is being actively exploited in the wild.
The authentication bypass flaw, which does not yet have a CVE identifier, is tracked as VSA-2026-062.
"REST cookie parsing turns authenticationToken=j:%7B%7D into {}," Vates VMS said in an alert. "REST authentication passes that object to the XO token provider without requiring a string."
"The token collection treats {} as an unfiltered lookup and returns its first token; the provider authenticates as that token's owner if it is unexpired. The authenticated /rest/v0/users/me/authentication_tokens route then returns reusable login token IDs."
In other words, the vulnerability can allow an attacker to bypass authentication by sending a specially crafted cookie and perform arbitrary actions with "Admin" privileges, ultimately resulting in arbitrary code execution on managed pools and a full XCP-ng node takeover as root.
Vates VMS said it's seeing the vulnerability being actively exploited by a threat actor from the following IP address and TOR domain -
- 91.211.251[.]112:8001, which has been flagged as a RedLine Stealer command-and-control (C2) server on VirusTotal
- ustar3rqxgnskzgnwkgpofgtvxevm6cx3lxdbwt4mndtveqyaohid[.]onion:3333
It's unclear when the activity started and if the vulnerability was exploited as a zero-day.

El resultado indica si la dirección figura en alguna filtración y, si es así, en cuáles. También permite suscribirse para recibir un aviso cuando el correo aparezca en una filtración futura.

Desde esa fecha tendrán que avisar en 72 horas de cualquier incidente crítico de seguridad de sus modelos.
La obligación surge de la ley RAISE, que regula a los llamados desarrolladores de frontera: empresas que entrenan los modelos más potentes, definidos por la ley como aquellos entrenados con más de 10^26 operaciones de cálculo. Las obligaciones más duras recaen sobre las que facturan más de USD 500 millones al año.

articles.title: Git Patches Flaw That Lets Malicious Repositories Execute Code During Recursive Clones
articles.summary:
A flaw in Git can let a malicious repository run an attacker's code on a computer that clones it recursively, together with its submodules. The Git project fixed it this week in Git 2.56.1, with matching fixes for the 2.50 through 2.55 series in 2.50.2, 2.51.3, 2.52.1, 2.53.1, 2.54.1 and 2.55.1.
The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-111760, is an integer truncation in how Git handles its index. An extremely long path in a repository can pass Git's safety check, but Git then writes it to disk under a shorter name that an attacker can set to .git.
This lets an attacker replace a submodule's .git file with a symbolic link to a folder holding malicious hooks or configuration. Hooks are programs Git runs at set points, so once Git uses that folder, the attacker's code can run.
Submodules matter here because Git refuses to replace a .git folder with a symbolic link, but in a freshly cloned submodule, .git is a file.
The fixed versions, listed in the Git project's release announcement, refuse such extremely long paths before their length can be cut short.
GitHub, which ships Git in its own tools, explained the fixes in a detailed write-up. It advises installing a fixed version from your operating system or Git distributor, and updating any app that ships its own copy of Git.
The company has already applied the fixes to github.com and GitHub Enterprise Cloud. For GitHub Enterprise Server, they are in versions 3.19.15, 3.20.11, 3.21.9 and 3.22.4.

Rating their perception of AI use, the academic staff who responded to the research recorded an average of 5.23 out of 7, whereas students recorded 3.11 on average.
The research highlights the differences in how AI is viewed among educators and students, with generative AI the focus. It is also commonly used for research, finding answers to assignments, and other tasks where finding sources needs to be more efficient.

Running your own Amnezia VPN server? You need to patch this critical Linux flaw now
Self-hosted Amnezia servers running Xray need a kernel update, a reboot, and a fresh Xray install to close a critical Linux hole
- Amnezia VPN has published a three-step guide to protect self-hosted servers from a critical Linux kernel flaw
- Servers running the Xray protocol face the highest risk
- Amnezia Premium, Free, and Business users don't need to do anything
Amnezia VPN has warned people who run their own servers through its app that a critical Linux kernel flaw leaves them exposed, and those using the Xray protocol need to rebuild their setups to stay safe.
The bug, tracked as CVE-2026-98432, sits in the code Linux uses to accept new IPv4 TCP connections and has been present since Linux 4.4. The kernel's security team gave it a severity score of 9.8 out of 10.
Even the best VPN is only as secure as the server it runs on, and that's the problem here. Amnezia VPN says its Premium, Free, and Business services are unaffected because the provider has already updated and audited its own infrastructure. Self-hosted users, however, have to act themselves.

articles.title: Microsoft corrige 1 235 failles lors du Patch Tuesday de novembre 2026, dont un zero-day Outlook
articles.summary:
Des pirates ont piégé des fichiers de message Outlook pour récupérer de quoi se connecter à votre place sur un réseau Windows. Microsoft a corrigé cette faille, exploitée avant la sortie du correctif, avec plus de 1 200 autres dans son Patch Tuesday de novembre.
Le Patch Tuesday cherche-t-il à battre un record cette année ? En janvier, l’éditeur avait corrigé 114 failles. En octobre, il a battu son record avec 1 411 vulnérabilités, selon notre dernier décompte. Pour Microsoft cette hausse, c'est la faute de l’intelligence artificielle, que ses équipes emploient pour fouiller son code. Avec 1 235 vulnérabilités, le lot de novembre est un peu moins lourd. Dans ce butin, Microsoft a corrigé une faille d’Outlook que des pirates exploitaient avant la sortie du correctif. Un zero-day de plus.
Des pirates exploitent Outlook pour récupérer votre identité Windows
Pour tomber dans le piège, vous devez ouvrir un fichier de message conçu par le pirate, reçu par exemple en pièce jointe d’un e-mail. Un pirate ne peut pas déclencher l’attaque par le simple affichage du message dans le volet de lecture. C'est ce qu'explique Microsoft dans son bulletin de sécurité : « L’ouverture du fichier pourrait amener Outlook à se connecter à un emplacement réseau contrôlé par l’attaquant sans afficher l’avertissement habituel concernant le contenu externe ».
